# Reader { #questionsafe.Reader }

```python
Reader(path, *, answer_dir=None, question_dir=None)
```

Read a single question from a Markdown file with YAML front matter.

Usage
- md = Reader("path/to/a_question.md")
- q = md.read()  # -> a Question instance (e.g., Q.SingleChoice)

Supported types (initial): singlechoice

Parameters
- path: the Markdown file to read.
- answer_dir: base directory to resolve include: entries. If None, resolves relative to the document’s directory. Includes are merged single-level only; nested include keys inside included files are ignored.
- question_dir: base directory to resolve cloze.file entries (embedded sub-questions). If None, resolves relative to the cloze document’s directory.
